messages.subject: Re: Installing leaflet package failed
parts:
Hmm. The error message said sp was not found (hence raster could not
be installed, then leaflet failed), but apparently you successfully
loaded it into R. It sounds like a devtools problem? Have you tried to
just install.packages('leaflet') from CRAN?

Regards,
Yihui
